I couldn't do this research, so there are no notes to give you. My first attempt to open the sources was refused with a message saying I had no tool calls left, and a second try failed the same way. Nothing loaded: no Enduring Word, BibleHub (Gill, Ellicott, Pulpit), StudyLight, Precept Austin, NET Bible notes or any of the other sites on your list.

You asked me to report only what the pages say, give a URL for each point and leave out anything I couldn't find. Since I read nothing, writing notes on Job 26 from memory would break those rules, so I've left everything out.

**Next step:** ask again in a new turn and I'll start with these pages:
- enduringword.com/bible-commentary/job-26/
- biblehub.com/commentaries/ellicott/job/26.htm (also /pulpit/ and /gill/ for the same chapter)
- netbible.org (translators' notes on Job 26)
- preceptaustin.org (a Job 26 page, if they have one)
- Searches on the other allowed sites for vv. 5–6 (the dead, Sheol and Abaddon), v. 7 ("hangs the earth upon nothing"), vv. 12–13 (Rahab and the fleeing serpent) and v. 14 (the "fringes of His ways")

Those are the verses most likely to show different views between traditions or from scholars.
